lead.headline: Saturday's moves change nothing for you: Tate is still questionable, Barkley stays off injured reserve
lead.deck: Your lineup is still the projection lineup. Tennessee raised no receiver behind Tate. London kicks off half an hour after tomorrow's edition.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players, which a full day did not improve. Carnell Tate is still questionable after two limited practices on the back he tightened up on Thursday, and there is still no first-hand word from his coach: 'good to go' reaches you only through reporters. The one new sign is in his favour and small: Tennessee used a practice-squad elevation on a defensive back and none on a receiver. Saquon Barkley is out for London and Philadelphia did not put him on injured reserve today. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. You lead 28–1 on George Pickens's 13-target Thursday; ESPN has it 133.6 to 122.3 and 56%, which with eight players each to come is close to even. Lawrence, Tuten and the Jaguars' defence play at 07:30 on Sunday, half an hour after tomorrow's edition; none has a designation after Saturday's moves, and the Eagles' own preview has Will Shipley starting behind a line with three new names. Elsewhere: Arizona are trading Marvin Harrison Jr., a free agent in this league with nowhere yet to play; Michael Pittman Jr. went on injured reserve, which leaves Roman Wilson a month of room; and a correction to this morning, Green Bay is sunny, not wet. Nothing needs doing today.
